entries.d207aa438b0febb8: This business leases rental housing built by the company, which it takes over in bulk from landlords and rents out to tenants. It also covers tenant brokerage, acting as guarantor and building management. It is the largest of the five categories by sales.
entries.d4cf1aa9f7ca9728: In April 2008, the company merged DAITO KYOUSAIKAI CO., LTD. into DAITO TATEMONO KANRI CO., LTD. DAITO TATEMONO KANRI CO., LTD. changed its name to DAITO TRUST PARTNERS CO., LTD. in April 2017.

entries.d8c6f85018523f34: Enter the propane gas supply business
entries.d9416f416b17f75a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,984,743 million, up 7.7% from ¥1,842,357 million in the previous fiscal year (the fiscal year ended March 2025). Revenue from external customers was ¥1,203,091 million for the Real Estate Leasing Business, ¥544,283 million for the Construction Business, ¥147,083 million for the Real Estate Development Business, ¥12,808 million for the Financial Business and ¥77,475 million for Other. The Real Estate Leasing Business rose 3.3% against a background of an increase in bulk-leased properties and high occupancy rates; bulk leasing accounted for ¥1,065,410 million (88.6%) of it. The Real Estate Development Business rose 186.5%, reflecting the effect of making Ascot Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary and an increase in the number of income property (development sales) buildings sold.
entries.d96cb451d38df629: Landlords who own land and build rental housing
entries.da512ee98316cf56: The company proposes effective land use, enters into a construction contract, and designs and builds the rental housing. After completion, consolidated subsidiary Daito Kentaku Partners Co., Ltd. enters into a bulk leasing contract with the landlord under the “Rental Management Entrustment System” and a sublease contract with the tenants. Tenant brokerage is handled by Daito Kentaku Leasing Co., Ltd. and Housecom Group; the company also handles development and sale of income properties and investment condominiums, construction financing and LP gas sales. The number of managed units is 1,351,329, up 2.2% from the previous year.
entries.dac237a115662970: Supply of LP gas and other fuels
entries.daf73617f3677109: This business buys income-generating properties, renovates them and sells them. It is carried out by DAITO TRUST ASSET SOLUTIONS CO., LTD., and in the United States by Amethyst Investment, LLC., which buys income-generating properties, renovates them and resells them. Sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥33,699 million, an increase from ¥10,479 million in the previous fiscal year.
entries.de82ae3ecacd7f8b: In November 2020, the company acquired all shares of Invalance Co., Ltd. It remains a consolidated subsidiary.

entries.e8db827317bc61aa: The group consists of the company, 71 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and five affiliates, and it provides comprehensive services to landowners considering land utilization through the building leasing business, from planning, construction and real estate brokerage to property management. The [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are four: the Construction Business, Real Estate Leasing Business, Real Estate Development Business and Financial Business; LP gas supply, nursing care and other services are “Other” businesses that are not included in the reportable segments. The number of employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is 19,326.

entries.f04ee9ee7770cf4b: Starting the structure of 3 key Group companies
entries.f0cb3912b303df8c: Counterparties to construction contracts are landlords who build rental housing as effective use of their land; rental housing accounts for 92.0% of completed construction revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Completed rental housing is leased to tenants; the rent-based occupancy rate in March 2026 was 98.0% for residential use and 99.4% for business use. The occupancy rate is calculated as “1 − (rent paid for leased vacant properties / total rent).” No single counterparty accounts for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.

entries.feb5bd4f540c644e: This event is behind the significant increase in real estate development revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 from the prior year. The company cites the effect of making Ascot Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary as a reason for the increase in revenue.
entries.ff930ef8cf1af669: Under the "Rental Management Commission System," DAITO TRUST PARTNERS CO., LTD. enters into bulk lease contracts with landlords to lease buildings and enters into sublease contracts with tenants to rent them out. Sales from bulk lease in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,065,410 million, an increase of 2.7% from ¥1,036,985 million in the previous fiscal year. The reasons are the increase in properties under bulk lease and the increase in rental income.
